facts.kind: *Test.php files with PHPUnit test cases or Pest tests

action-pinning.message: all 6 actions are pinned to a commit

ci-lint.message: CI lints its configuration (GitHub Actions: actionlint, zizmor)

ci-present.message: CI configuration found for GitHub Actions

compiler-warnings.message: strict PHP error reporting settings are enabled: error_reporting = E_ALL

copy-paste-detection.message: CI runs copy-paste detection with jscpd

coverage.message: branch coverage is reported with PHPUnit; path coverage bonus: PHPUnit

dependency-audit.message: CI audits the dependencies with composer audit

dependency-management.message: dependencies are declared in composer.json (Composer) and locked in composer.lock

dependency-updates.message: automated dependency updates are configured with Dependabot

function-limits.message: function length is limited with lizard

large-files.message: no committed file is larger than 5 MiB

license.message: the project is licensed under MIT

platform-matrix.message: CI covers 3 OS(es) (linux, macos, windows), 2 PHP version(s) (8.3, 8.4), 6 combination(s)

secret-scanning.message: secrets are scanned for with gitleaks

security-policy.message: SECURITY.md says how to report a vulnerability

security-scanning.message: CI scans the code for security problems with Psalm taint analysis

status-badges.message: README.md shows CI (GitHub Actions) and quality (Codecov) badges

type-checking.message: PHPStan (phpstan.neon.dist) and Psalm run; strict mode bonus: PHPStan (phpstan.neon.dist)

warnings-as-errors.message: warnings are treated as errors with PHPUnit failOnWarning, failOnNotice and failOnDeprecation
